title: docs(skills): platform skill describes the blank starter as shipped — requires automation+triggers, seven barrels via exportsOf
body:
Fixes #20385
Clause-②: no

## What was false, and what the skill now says

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 〈The Template〉 said the blank starter declares `requires: ['automation']` and said nothing about the barrel wiring. Read on the branch base `df3ba164` (`origin/main` at claim time), `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts` declares `requires: ['automation', 'triggers']` (line 51), keeps the three generic connector executors in `plugins:` (lines 61–65: `ConnectorRestPlugin`, `ConnectorOpenApiPlugin`, `ConnectorMcpPlugin`), and hands all seven generator barrels (`objects`, `views`, `actions`, `flows`, `dashboards`, `apps`, `skills`) to the stack key of the same name through `exportsOf` (lines 73–79; six of the barrels are `export {};`). #20363 landed the template change; the card behind it, #20333, is not addressed here.

The bullet now states those facts and points at the scaffolded `AGENTS.md` for how to add to the barrels — one pointer, not a second spelling of its rule (the claim's judgement). The pointer names the file without a rule number so a later renumbering of that list cannot make the skill stale again.

## Sentence-by-sentence audit of the starter's description (the execution note)

| Where (line on the base) | Sentence | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 192–194, 〈The Template〉 | `requires: ['automation']` plus the three connector executors | FALSE on `requires` (no `triggers`) and SILENT on the seven barrels → rewritten |
| same bullet | "the three generic connector executors in `plugins:`" | TRUE (lines 61–65 of the template) → kept |
| same bullet | "The memory driver and the Hono server are NOT in the file — the CLI auto-registers both at boot" | TRUE (no driver or server plugin in the file) → kept |
| 357–366, `requires:` table | `triggers` row | already present (`@objectstack/trigger-record-change`, plus `trigger-schedule` and `trigger-api`) → no row added; its bold "Pair it with `job`" clause restated rule 5 under the same table → dropped from the row, rule 5 keeps it in full |
| 399, the five rules | "Keep `automation` whenever `plugins:` lists a connector" | TRUE for the starter → unchanged |
| 401, the five rules | "Pair `triggers` with `job`" | TRUE → unchanged, now the one spelling |
| 225, the directory tree | `flows/ # Optional: automation flows` | a project convention, not the starter → unchanged |
| 245, naming table | `Object.values(imported)` | still true — `exportsOf` is a typed `Object.values` → unchanged |
| `references/bootstrap.md` § Scaffolding Command | "blank is the default, and the only, template" | TRUE → unchanged |

## Paying the skills token ratchet (headroom 2 → 4)

Net content added by the rewritten bullet is paid by deleting redundancy in the same file, nothing moved elsewhere and the ceiling untouched:

- The retired-templates paragraph (four lines) is one sentence. The CLI already prints `Template "NAME" has been retired and is no longer available.` when one is asked for by name (`packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts`, line 414), so the skill needs the fact, not the marketplace history.
- The `triggers` table row drops the "Pair it with `job` — schedule and time-relative triggers run on the job service" clause; rule 5 directly under the table says the same thing with its consequence, and every other row in that table lists providers only.
- "works offline, no network fetch" → "no network fetch" (one claim, said once).

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- `## Project Structure Conventions` (lines 209–232) lists no `src/skills/` directory, while the starter now ships one with its own barrel. That section describes a project convention, not the starter; class: none of a/b/c; carrier: none.
- Line 245's naming row spells the barrel hand-off as `Object.values(imported)`; the starter spells it `exportsOf(barrel)`, a typed `Object.values`. Both true; carrier: none.
- "Bundled with `create-objectstack` — no network fetch" describes the template itself; the scaffold's separate skills-install step (`npx -y skills add …`) does fetch. Pre-existing claim, shortened here without changing its substance; carrier: none.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:平台技能(`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`)里描述 `blank` 起步模板的那一段,改成与实际发出的模板一致:`requires` 现在是 `['automation', 'triggers']`,并说明七个目录 barrel(objects/views/actions/flows/dashboards/apps/skills)都已经通过 `exportsOf` 接到同名 stack 键,加一句指向脚手架生成的 `AGENTS.md` 说明怎么往里加东西。为了不超过技能包的 token 上限,同一文件里删了三处重复表述(退役模板段落压成一句、`triggers` 表格行不再重复规则 5、"works offline / no network fetch" 只说一次)。

**为什么改**:技能是 AI 写应用时读的说明书;这句话过时后,AI 按它描述起步项目会漏掉 `triggers`(`objectstack generate flow` 生成的 flow 装不上),也不知道 barrel 已经接好,可能手加 stack 键而不是从 barrel 导出。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文档改动,不动代码、不动发布包(`skills/**` 不在任何已发布包的 `files[]` 里,已实测);风险只在措辞被误读,已逐句对照模板文件核过并列在上表。回滚:revert 本 PR 的一个 commit 即可,无其它依赖。
